purpose: combined: payload-psiz (libredwoodair: point size fix + guarded shader compilation, guest-psiz.sh) then payload-camback (com.apple.camera preferences: start on the back camera in Photo, guest-camback.sh); each part has its own undo

parts.purpose: Driver fix: Nord2Metal.bundle/libredwoodair.dylib replaced by y2s40 = the installed y2s39 library (reproduced bit for bit) with one object changed, air_metal.c, in two places. (1) finalize_for_gallium marks a vertex shader's [[point_size]] output medium precision before the I/O is lowered, which is what Panfrost's Valhall compiler needs to store it as the 16-bit float it then looks for: without it bi_compile_variant read through NULL (no assertions in this build) and Camera.app died at every launch compiling CameraUI's ShutterLiquidVertex (run q10hk-dual; reproduced on the build machine with that metallib). (2) the calls that hand a shader to the back end (create_vs_state / create_fs_state / create_compute_state) run with this thread's faults caught: a fault inside the compiler makes the pipeline's creation fail with a sentence instead of ending the process. Nord2Metal itself is NOT changed (checked to be the y2s38 one). Previous library kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/libredwoodair.dylib.pre-psiz; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-psiz-undo.sh.

camera test aid: com.apple.camera's CAMUserPreferenceCaptureDevice set to 0 (back, automatic) and CAMUserPreferenceCaptureMode to 0 (Photo), so that the next start of Camera.app asks for the back camera (the dual-wide device) at once instead of the front one it was left on (run q10hk never got to the back cameras). The values that were there are kept in com.apple.camera.plist.pre-camback (a small plist). Undo: guest-camback-undo.sh.
